method: Same likelihood with the shifted data vector; best fits and grid posterior
text: Impact of the offset: subtracting 0.04 mag from the DES5Y low-z sub-samples gives LCDM Omega_m 0.310 (chi2 1635.7) 'in near perfect agreement' with Planck; w0waCDM Omega_m 0.426, w0 -1.068, wa -2.63, chi2 1633.4, a chi2 reduction of 2.5 (text; 2.3 from the legends), 'no statistically significant preference'; the shifted DES5Y posterior is consistent with w0 = -1, wa = 0 and still skewed to high Omega_m.
rests_on: Abstract: 'Systematics of this order can bring the DES5Y sample into good agreement with the Planck LCDM cosmology and Pantheon+'
revision_note: Location only: figure numbers corrected to the TeX caption order (PROTOCOL Addendum A2). Statement, method and criteria unchanged from r1.
